name: svelteContextKind

versions.rationale: Tells which exported variables are Svelte contexts (ADR 0021, #74): what createContext from svelte returns, destructured or whole, or a module-level const the same module passes to setContext, getContext or hasContext as the key. A literal key has no declaration to be a unit of, so it is not tracked.

docs:
Whether an exported variable is a Svelte context (ADR 0021): what `createContext()` from `svelte` returns, whether
destructured into its getter and setter or kept whole, or a module-level constant that the same module passes to
`setContext`, `getContext` or `hasContext` as the key.
